tos.title: Terms of use for client.webspeak3.de
tos.rule1: This client is for private, non-commercial use of TeamSpeak/TeaSpeak/GreenTeaSpeak servers via the browser.
tos.rule2: Prohibited in particular: any criminal activity, harassment and hate speech, spam and flooding, disrupting the service, and circumventing bans.
tos.rule3: Violations may result in access being blocked without warning; serious cases may be reported to the relevant authorities.
tos.rule4Pre: For operational security and abuse detection, connections are logged (server address, server name, timestamp) and automatically deleted after 90 days – see the
tos.rule5Pre: For abuse or complaints: see the
tos.rule6: By clicking "Accept" you agree to these terms. Your acceptance is stored only locally in your browser; you'll be asked again if the rules change.

sync.subtitle: Your data on all your devices
sync.intro: An account is just a random number, optionally with a password. No email, no name. Everything is encrypted on your device before it is uploaded. The server only sees unreadable data.
sync.create.title: New account
sync.create.withPasswordHint: Without a password, the account number alone gives access to your data.
sync.login.title: Existing account
sync.login.hint: The account's data then replaces the data on this device.
sync.serverHint: Leave empty for the official server. An account only exists on the server it was created on.
sync.account.title: Your account
sync.keepSafe: Keep the number and password safe. If you lose them, nobody can recover your data, not even us.
sync.qr.hint: Scan it with the other device to log in there. Anyone who sees this code can access your account.
sync.password.addConfirm: Generate a new random password? Other devices will have to log in again with number and password.
sync.password.removeConfirm: Remove the password? The account number alone will then be enough. Other devices will have to log in again.
sync.categoriesHint: Audio devices, volumes, PTT key and chat logs always stay on the device.
sync.conflict.title: Sync
sync.conflict.text: Both this device and the account changed since the last sync. Which one should win?
sync.logoutConfirm: Log this device out of the account? The account and its data are kept.
sync.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete the account and all its data on the server? The data on this device stays.
sync.link.title: Connect to account
sync.link.prompt: Connect this device to account {number}? The account's data replaces the data on this device.

sync.error.conflict: Another device changed something in the meantime.
